name: Clerk
billing_unit_note: Monthly Retained User — counted only if the user returns 24+ hours after signup
summary: Hobby free to 50k MRU/app. Pro $25/mo ($20 annual) with 50k MRU + 1 SSO + 1 Directory Sync. Extra SSO $75 (2–15) then $60 (16–100) and $48 (101–250). Directory Sync billed from 2027-01-01.

name: Auth0
billing_unit_note: Monthly active users (external). Paid plans are sold in published MAU tiers (500 up to 50k B2C / 20k B2B); usage between tiers is billed at the next tier up. Enterprise is contact sales.
summary: Free to 25k MAU with 1 Enterprise Connection, Self-Service SSO and inbound SCIM. B2C Essentials runs $35 (500 MAU) → $700 (10k) → $3,500 (50k)/mo; B2C Professional $240 → $1,600 (10k) → $3,200 (20k). B2B Essentials $150 (500) → $2,100 (10k) → $3,800 (20k) with 3 SSO connections; B2B Professional $800 → $2,400 (10k) with 5. Extra SSO connections $100/mo. Yearly = 11× monthly. Above those tiers: Enterprise, contact sales.

name: Amazon Cognito
billing_unit_note: Lite / Essentials / Plus tiers. Direct+social vs SAML/OIDC federated priced separately.
summary: Essentials (default) free 10k MAU then $0.015/MAU (direct/social). Lite free 10k then $0.0055 / $0.0046 bands. Plus $0.020/MAU no free tier. Federated SAML/OIDC: 50 free then $0.015/MAU.

name: WorkOS
billing_unit_note: AuthKit free to 1M MAU; SSO and Directory Sync billed per connection with volume bands.
summary: AuthKit free to 1M MAU then $2,500/mo per additional 1M. SSO and Directory Sync each: $125 (1–15), $100 (16–30), $80 (31–50), $65 (51–100).

name: Stytch
billing_unit_note: Pay-as-you-go. Free includes 10k MAU and 5 SSO or SCIM connections. Per-MAU overage rate not printed as a fixed dollar amount on the page we checked.
summary: B2B pay-as-you-go: $0 base, 10k MAU + 5 SSO/SCIM included, then $125 per additional connection. Custom brand $99. MAU overage rate not published as a fixed figure on the checked page.

name: Logto
billing_unit_note: Token-based (access tokens counted). Free to 50k MAU. Pro from $24/mo with token overage and add-ons.
summary: Free: 50k MAU / 50k tokens. Pro from $24/mo: unlimited MAU, 50k tokens then $0.08 per 100 extra. Enterprise SSO add-on $48/connector. MFA add-on $48. Organizations add-on $48.

name: Kinde
billing_unit_note: 10,500 MAU free on every plan. Users on paid subscriptions billed through Kinde are not counted as MAU.
summary: Free $0 / Pro $25 / Plus $75 / Scale $250. Each includes 10,500 MAU; Pro overage $0.0175/MAU. Plus and Scale include unlimited enterprise SSO at no per-connection fee. Free/Pro include 1 SSO connection.

name: Supabase Auth
billing_unit_note: Auth MAU is part of the Supabase org plan (not a standalone auth SKU). Plan fee also covers database compute credits.
summary: Free: 50k MAU. Pro from $25/mo: 100k MAU then $0.00325/MAU. SAML SSO: 50 included then $0.015/MAU. Auth-only cost is entangled with the platform plan.

name: Firebase Auth / Identity Platform
billing_unit_note: Firebase Authentication with Identity Platform bills Google Cloud Identity Platform rates: Tier 1 (email, phone, anonymous, social) per MAU in volume bands; Tier 2 (SAML/OIDC) per federated MAU; phone/MFA per SMS sent. firebase.google.com/pricing lists no cost up to 50K MAUs and 50 SAML/OIDC MAUs, then Google Cloud pricing.
summary: No cost up to 50k MAU (email, phone, anonymous, social), then $0.0055/MAU to 100k, $0.0046 to 1M, $0.0032 to 10M, $0.0025 above. SAML/OIDC: 50 MAU free then $0.015/MAU. SMS (phone sign-in and MFA) billed per message by region (US $0.01); first 10 SMS a day not billed. Sources: cloud.google.com/identity-platform/pricing and firebase.google.com/pricing.

name: Descope
billing_unit_note: Plans include MAUs, monthly active tenants and SSO connections; Pro and Growth bill overages. Free has hard limits (no overages; upgrade required).
summary: Free Forever $0: 7,500 MAU, 10 tenants, 3 SSO connections, no overages. Pro starts at $249/mo billed annually: 10,000 MAU then $0.05/MAU, 35 tenants then $1, 5 SSO then $50/connection. Growth starts at $799/mo: 25,000 MAU then $0.05/MAU, 100 tenants, 10 SSO then $50, SCIM. Enterprise: contact sales.

name: Scalekit
billing_unit_note: MAU and monthly active organizations, plus per-connection SSO and SCIM ladders (first of each free).
summary: Free $0: 25k MAU, 25 orgs, 1 SSO + 1 SCIM (hard caps). Growth $99/mo: 100k MAU then $0.05, 100 orgs then $1; SSO and SCIM each 1 free then $60 (2–15), $45 (16–30), $35 (31–50), $30 (51–100).

name: SSOJet
billing_unit_note: No per-user or per-MAU charge. Business bills each production SSO or SCIM link as one connection on a shared volume ladder; Free has unlimited users but no enterprise SSO/SCIM.
summary: Free $0 forever: unlimited users/MAUs/orgs, no enterprise SSO or SCIM. Business: monthly list $79/conn (2–4), $72 (5–9), $65 (10–24), $55 (25–49), $47 (50–99); annual ~25% less. SSO and SCIM each count as one connection on the same ladder.
